jobs.name: Daily Walk & Talk episode
jobs.title: A new episode every day
jobs.what: Claude picks a calm topic (Journal Club with a real dog paper on Fridays), writes and records the episode, and runs the Legal Desk check. It appears in this app only if the check is GREEN. You get a notification either way.

jobs.name: Tuesday dog news pick
jobs.title: Tuesday: choose a dog news story
jobs.what: Sends you up to 3 cheerful dog stories from this week. Pick one for a Dog news episode.

jobs.name: Thursday Journal Club pick
jobs.title: Thursday: choose Friday's paper
jobs.what: Sends you up to 3 real dog science papers. Pick one for Friday's Journal Club. If you don't pick, Friday's automatic episode finds one itself.
